name: Troll Witchery
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic.  Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you.  I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have those fetishes, adventurer? They might hold the secret to Kurzen's degradation...I must know!
